_about: Single source of truth for every modelling assumption. Each entry: value, unit, source, note. Read by pipeline/build_data.py and src/sim. Generic aircraft profiles only; manufacturer pages are cited as evidence for the class, not modelled as products.

callsDataset.source: DataSF, Law Enforcement Dispatched Calls for Service: Closed, https://data.sf.gov/d/2zdj-bwza (PDDL)
callsDataset.note: Domain moved from data.sfgov.org to data.sf.gov in 2026; old host 301-redirects.

callFilter.note: 911-originated police calls only. On-view calls (officer already present), HSOC, MTA, Sheriff and HEART are excluded because a drone cannot beat an officer who initiated the call.

districtsDataset.note: New SFPD boundaries effective 2026-10-01. Every call is re-assigned to these boundaries by point-in-polygon so historical days can be replayed under the new districts.

locationMasking.source: DataSF dataset description (Feb 2025 revision note: consistent geo-masked intersections applied to all history)
locationMasking.note: Error is at most about half a block (~50-100 m), small next to 1-3 km flights. Calls with no location and sensitive calls (location withheld) are excluded and counted.

maxResponseRadiusKm.source: Assumption (2 miles), common DFR planning radius per dock.
maxResponseRadiusKm.note: Calls farther than this from every dock are missed as out of range, even if battery would allow it.

skipDuplicateCalls.note: Calls flagged as duplicates of another CAD event are not flown twice.

defaultCallTypes.source: SFPD Drone Flight Logs (giw5-ttjs): most-flown original call types 2024-2026 are wanted/suspicious vehicle, person w/ gun, suspicious person, burglary, assault, auto boost, fight, person w/ knife, robbery, stolen vehicle. Extended with alarms, prowler, break-in, injury accidents, missing persons, vandalism, trespasser.
defaultCallTypes.note: 917 suspicious person, 916 suspicious vehicle, 459 burglary, 221 person w/ gun, 222 person w/ knife, 216 shots fired, 418 fight no weapon, 240 assault/battery, 245 agg assault/ADW, 212 strongarm robbery, 211 robbery, 852 auto boost/strip, 851 stolen vehicle, 1030 wanted vehicle, 100A audible alarm, 603 prowler, 602 person breaking in, 519 injury vehicle accident, 519HR hit-and-run injury, 809 missing adult, 807 missing juvenile, 594 vandalism, 601 trespasser.

excludedByDefault.note: Domestic violence, mental health and suicide attempts, and noise complaints are off by default: aerial video inside or near homes raises privacy questions that a pilot program would likely settle in policy first. All are toggleable.

defaultPriorities.source: Trial Phoenix registration (AEA RCT 18198) targets lower-priority calls; Mission Local 2026-06 on SoMa pilot.
defaultPriorities.note: All priorities are eligible by default; results are always split by priority so queue-driven gains on B/C are not confused with speed.

launchS.source: Vendor DFR claim: 'launch in under 20 seconds', https://www.skydio.com/solutions/dfr
launchS.note: From launch decision to en route: dock open, takeoff.

cruiseAltitudeFt.note: Typical DFR transit altitude; used for climb time and (later) the FAA facility-map ceiling check.

climbRateMs.source: Assumption, typical enterprise multirotor ascent rate.

cruiseSpeedMs.source: Published class specs: 20 m/s max (16 m/s with obstacle avoidance active), https://skydio.com/x10/technical-specs ; 21 m/s sport / 15 m/s normal, https://enterprise.dji.com/dock-2/specs
cruiseSpeedMs.note: 18 m/s (~40 mph) sits between obstacle-avoidance-on and max speed for transit at 200 ft AGL.

landingS.note: Descent from cruise altitude, precision landing and dock close at the end of the return leg.

enduranceMin.source: Published class specs: 40 min max flight (35 min hover), https://skydio.com/x10/technical-specs ; 50 min max flight (40 min hover), https://enterprise.dji.com/dock-2/specs

reservePct.note: Drone leaves scene when remaining battery would drop below this after the return leg.

minLaunchPct.note: A drone is only offered for a response with at least this charge (and always enough for out, back, minimum on-scene time and reserve). Without it, a single drone recycles on near-empty batteries and flies far more, far shorter missions than real programs report.

chargeRatePctPerMin.source: Published dock spec: 20->90% in ~32 min, https://enterprise.dji.com/dock-2/specs

label.note: Vertical take-off, transitions to wing-borne flight; orbits the scene instead of hovering.

cruiseSpeedMs.source: Vendor DFR page: fixed-wing layer 'up to 100 mph' (44.7 m/s), https://www.skydio.com/solutions/dfr
cruiseSpeedMs.note: Cruise (~90 mph) set a little under the quoted maximum.

launchS.note: Hub open, vertical take-off and transition to forward flight; slower than a multirotor dock launch.

landingS.note: Transition back to hover, descent and landing in the hub.

enduranceMin.source: Vendor DFR page: '2 hours or more' endurance, https://www.skydio.com/solutions/dfr

chargeRatePctPerMin.note: Larger pack: about 65 min from 20% to full.

responseRadiusKm.note: Covers all of San Francisco from any hub in the city.

maxConcurrentDrones.note: Active missions one operator can supervise at once (launch until the drone leaves the scene).
